notes.title: Escape From Duckov is officially launching on October 16th!
notes.content:
[h1]Quack quack! The wait is almost over! [/h1][p]After two exciting demo tests and countless hours of hard work from Jeff, we're happly to announce that our Duckov will open its gates to welcome all ducklings on October 16th!
[/p][p]​​Launch Price:​​ ​​[b]$17.99[/b] USD​​
Launch Discount (First 2 Weeks Only!)​​ → ​​Just [b]$15.83[/b] USD​​ (Save ~12%!🕊️💸)[/p][previewyoutube="_ZKhiHIAeO4;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]What’s New in the Full Release?[/h3][p]• New Items: More gear to quack about — gear up for adventure![/p][p]• New NPCs: Meet fresh faces in your shelter — new friends, new interactions![/p][p]• New Maps: Discover exciting new areas to waddle through and explore![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist Duckov on Steam and join our growing flock on Discord to share ideas, ask questions, and get the latest updates: [url="https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS"]https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
【Update Notice】
Fully exit and close the game client.
Update Method 1​: After closing the game, restart your game platform client. The platform will automatically detect and start downloading the update.
Update Method 2​: Alternatively: Find “Escape from Duckov Demo” in your game library and manually click the "Update" button.

【Update Content】
Updates
●Added new weapon and blueprint: MP-155 ULTIMA.
●You can now change difficulty and talents at the Base.
●Muddy now sells Recovery Injections, which continuously restore HP for 30 seconds after use.
●Electric MP7 damage increased (7.5 → 8.5).
●Rapid Lordon damage reduced by 10%.
●Wrench and Car Wrench are now melee weapons.
●Sledgehammer damage increased (30 → 36).
●Aiming speed improved for VPO (1 → 0.8) and Mosin-Nagant (0.95 → 0.75).
●Added something fun during rainy weather (watch out).
●New food item: Mushroom.
●Added item lock feature in the backpack (hotkey: L) for easier sorting and quick deposit.
●Pet Backpack UI position adjusted.
●M1A can now equip magazines.
Fixes:
●Removed demo-only blueprints from the Recipe Handbook and added unlockable ones.
●Fixed a bug caused by splitting items while performing other actions.
●Fixed AI not detecting enemies in close range.
●Attachments: Laser - Basic and Laser - Calibrated now properly reflect their effects in the stats panel.
●Fixed display issues in non-Simplified Chinese for some new tasks and items.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
【Update Notice】
Fully exit and close the game client.
Update Method 1​: After closing the game, restart your game platform client. The platform will automatically detect and start downloading the update.
Update Method 2​: Alternatively: Find “Escape from Duckov Demo” in your game library and manually click the "Update" button.

【Update Content】
Updates
● Implemented the [Unstuck] feature (can be used for cheating in some cases; abusing it may reduce the overall gameplay experience).
● Shovel, hammer, sledgehammer, crowbar, and golf club are now classified as melee weapons.
● Melee weapons now feature headshot and bleeding attributes.
● Added an early backpack upgrade (+5 slots).
● Added a “Store All to Warehouse” button to the backpack.
● Removed the damage penalty for high-penetration rounds (damage coefficient unified to 1).
● Reduced damage taken in the lowest difficulty (from 60% to 50%).
● Kills from bleeding now count toward objectives.
● Fog of war removed in the lowest difficulty.
● Reduced Dwarf Duck’s vision range and attack range by 10%. Also reduced the movement penalty when it is outside vision range.
● Camera no longer zooms while looting.
● Improved the shooting sound effects of Storm Creatures.
● Added additional enemy spawn points near the bunker in the Zero Area.
● Added a disassemble shortcut key (F).
● Added sound effects when completing objectives.
● Gun-related missions now automatically remove attachments upon submission.
Fixes
● Fixed an issue where headshots on Da Xingxing might miss.
● Fixed abnormal spread reduction behavior when aiming with certain guns.
● Fixed an issue where progress was not saved when exiting during evacuation.
● Fixed inconsistent results when organizing the backpack.
● Fixed duplication issue with Tail No.1 and No.3.
● Fixed the icon for L-type bullets.

notes.title: Answers to Some Questions Everyone is Concerned About
notes.content:
Recently, besides receiving a lot of suggestions from everyone, we’ve also encountered many issues that players have faced.
I’ve compiled some of the most common questions here for everyone to check out.
I used translation software, so if anything is unclear, please leave a comment and let me know!

[h1]About Basic Game Questions[/h1]
Q1: I really want to play with my friends! Does the game include a multiplayer mode?
A: Duckov is a single-player game and does not include multiplayer features.

Q2: Can I play it on my phone?
A: There are currently no plans to release it on mobile platforms...

Q3: Does the game support controllers?
A: Not at the moment.

Q4: Will it support MAC computers?
A: The current DEMO version does not support MAC, but the full release will!

Q5: Does the game support cloud saves?
A: The DEMO version does not support cloud saves, but the full version will. Also, Steam achievements will only be available in the full version.

Q6: Will there be a Steam Workshop?
A: This is still undecided. We’ll need to wait until the core development is complete before making a decision.

[h1]About Major Bugs in This Test[/h1]
Q1: Sometimes, the GPU usage is too high.
A: In the future, we’ll add an FPS cap setting. Currently, the cap is 144 FPS, which does put a high load on the GPU. We’ll also add more graphics settings to meet the needs of more players.

Q2: Why is my game screen purple?
A: Based on the information we’ve gathered, it’s likely because the game does not support integrated graphics cards. (orz)

Q3: If there’s a power outage or crash during gameplay, the save file will be lost.
A: QAQ First of all, we sincerely apologize for this issue. We’ve received multiple reports about this problem, and unfortunately, we currently cannot fix it. We’ve roughly identified the cause of the bug and will resolve it in the next test!

Q4: Strange map glitches and invisible walls.
A: Aaaah, please report these to us! We’ll fix them as soon as possible! (orz)

[h1]About Future Plans[/h1]
Q1: When will we be able to play next?
A: After this playtest ends, we’ll adjust the game based on the feedback we’ve received.
We’ll open another test during the Steam Next Fest in June! In terms of content, the next DEMO won’t include new maps, but we’ll optimize the tutorial, improve the quest experience, and address other frequently reported issues. Everything will be optimized!!
Around June, we’ll also finalize a release date for the full game. We’ll definitely deliver it this year!

Q2: What will the business model be like? How much will it cost?
A: Duckov will be a one-time purchase game with no in-game purchases. The exact price hasn’t been decided yet, but we’ll respect and consider everyone’s suggestions.

Q3: Will the current DEMO save files be compatible with the full version?
A: Actually, we can’t deliberately delete your save files (since they’re stored locally for single-player games).
However, because we’ve updated the game, old save files might trigger unexpected bugs.
Additionally, in the new version, we’ll update quests, optimize the early-game experience, adjust enemy and weapon stats, add official Steam achievements, and make a series of other adjustments.
Therefore, we recommend starting a new save file when the full game is released.
